notes:
Account background: mid-market SaaS (B2B product workflow automation). Product team (PM + Eng + Platform) evaluating Redwood after 6-week hosted API trial. Goal: ship contextual in-app assistant + vector search reranker for knowledge base. Interested in Hosted -> Dedicated path for predictable latency and data isolation.

Hosted trial summary (what we saw):
- Trial period: 2026-01-10 -> 2026-02-21. Used hosted_api for integration, telemetry via SDK.
- Sample load: average 9 QPS during weekday business hours; peak observed 42 QPS during internal beta push (peak window ~3 minutes).
- Token mix observed: chat prompts median ~220 tokens in, 350 tokens out (multi-turn state retained); reranking calls small, ~80 tokens; embeddings (512-d / open model) batched nightly, ~2.5M tokens/day when full sync runs.
- Latency: p50 ~110ms, p95 ~340ms on hosted trial with default batching; desire p95 < 250ms for in-app assistant.
- Cost: hosted API run-rate extrapolated to ~$0.09/token-equivalent for production traffic; cost sensitivity high — target is 30-50% lower unit cost with Dedicated.

POC ask / Dedicated sizing request (what they want us to model):
- Expected steady-state QPS after GA: 12 QPS average (weekday), with 20 QPS sustained during marketing campaigns.
- Expected peak: brief spikes to 75-90 QPS during launch days / feature rollouts (3–10 minute bursts).
- Concurrency target: aim to support peak concurrent requests ~80–100 with 2x headroom for KVA/cache warmups.
- Token mix for capacity planning: 65% chat (avg 600 tokens total per call considering multi-turn), 20% embeddings (batched nightly), 15% reranking/short calls (avg 120 tokens).
- Token throughput estimate: ~85M tokens/day at projected scale (includes nightly embedding sync).
- SLOs: p95 latency target 200–250ms for chat paths; embeddings can be background/batched.

Redwood team recommendations discussed in demo:
- Initial Dedicated pool to cover steady-state + 2x burst headroom: proposal sketched = 6x A100-80GB equiv (or 8x 40GB with quantized model) depending on model/quantization.
- Autoscale policy: baseline 4 GPUs, scale to 10 GPUs for burst windows; keep routing fallback to hosted_api for extreme overflow during first 90 days.
- Caching: enable prefix/KV caching for common prompt templates to reduce per-token compute.
- Suggested model variants: 1x low-latency quantized variant for chat, 1x high-quality full-precision for long-form generation.

Commercial / pricing notes:
- Customer wants blended committed commit for Dedicated (monthly) + overage pricing. Interested in an annual discount if we can guarantee <250ms p95 and a max committed qps.
- Procurement is evaluating two pricing scenarios: (A) 4 GPU reserved baseline + autoscale, (B) 6 GPU reserved with smaller autoscale. They requested Redwood to provide cost-per-token for both.
